description:
The Fourth Primogenitor—That's the world's strongest vampire that should only exist in legends. Accompanied by twelve Kenjuu and spreading calamity, this phantom vampire appeared in Japan. For the observation and obliteration of this Fourth Primogenitor, the government and Lion King decided to dispatch an attack mage known as a Sword Shaman. However, for some reason, the one chosen for the observation was a apprentice Sword Shaman girl, Himegari Yukina. Wielding the strongest anti-primogenitor spirit spear, Yukina arrived at Demon District, Itogami City. What is the true identity of the Fourth Primogenitor, Akatsuki Kojou, she encountered over there!?

(Source: Baka-Tsuki, edited)

node.description: Yukina Himeragi is the female protagonist of the series. She is an attack mage, or in the Lion King Organization, a Sword Shaman, who is sent by the Lion King Organization to observe the Fourth Primogenitor, Kojou Akatsuki. As she's appointed to observe him, she became a middle-school student studying in Saikai Academy who follows him everywhere and is also ordered to kill him if he becomes too powerful and insane to control himself. ~!She is also the first blood mate of Kojou, and thus being the first, her blood smell is always associated with Kojou's own smell, which has been pointed out many times by other characters who could smell blood, probably due to her blood interbreeding with Kojou's as she was the one who activated Kojou's first 'real' vampiric act. Also, unknown to her, she was intended and prepared by the Lion King Organization to be his lover.!~

Kojou was a normal high school student 3 months ago, until the original 4th primogenitor had released her spirit into him because of a wish she had granted him. It's possible they made a deal.

Sometimes, his vampire urges try to take over and his eyes are about to turn red. He usually gets a nosebleed and coughs. Yukina claims that it is impossible for a human being to randomly become the 4th primogenitor, but he can't remember any details of the incident.

As a vampire, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, and durability, but is much more powerful than normal vampires due to his status. He has also inherited Avrora's twelve familiars.

She is one of Kojou's classmates who works as a part-time computer programmer at the Security Department of "Itogami Island Management Corporation" in Level B. She is very proficient with computers and deciphering complicated codes, which is why she was kidnapped by Christoper Gardos to awaken the "Nalakuvera" a so called ancient weapon of the gods. She created an AI program that she calls "Mogwai" that she uses to help her break into any firewalls, to hack into any secured sites or create and alter any programs. It was pointed out she has feelings for Kojou.

Astarte was a homunculus servant of Rudolf Eustach until Kojou and Yukina defeated him. Since then she has been sentenced to 3 years probation and is currently entrusted to Natsuki, who made Astarte her maid.

Sayaka Kirasaka is a member of the Lion King Organization, which is assigned to the Multinational Magical Crimes under the Foreign Affairs Division. She is Dmitri Vatler's observer and is a "War Dancer" who specializes in using hexes and assassinations.

Kirasaka and Himeragi are very close and were former roommates during their training in the organization. Her unusual protective behavior for Himeragi may suggest that she has some sort of feelings for her. She also despises Kojou so much that she plans to eliminate him. 

She uses a sword called "Koukarin" that can nullify any physical attacks. It can also change into a bow called "Der Freischütz" which she uses to shoot magical arrows and spread any incantations over a wide area.
Friend of Nagisa Akatsuki who goes to the same school as her and Yukina Himeragi.

node.description:
She is the princess of Aldegyr and the third person to make a blood pact with Koujo.

She is related to Kanase Kanon, due to her grandfather having an affair.
She is Kojou's younger sister and is also Yukina's classmate. She is usually chatty with people she likes and is a very good cook.

Akatsuki Kojou's English teacher that claims to be 26 years old.

She also assists Itogami Island Security with investigating crimes perpetrated by supernatural beings around Itogami Island.

(Source: Wikipedia)

He is Kojou and Asagi's classmate. He is a member of the Far East District of the Lion-King Organization, and is the real observer of Kojou, the 4th progenitor, he is also Asagi's childhood friend and therefore often offers support to the latter for going after Kojou. He is actually an Esper whose special ability is called "Air Current Manipulation" which is the ability to manipulate air, vibrations and sound waves, but needs certain drugs or enhancers to strength his ability, he can also use his special ability to eavesdrop on anybody from any location most especially when listening on to Kojou and Asagi's conversation. 

(Source Wikipedia)

node.description:
He is a high ranking vampire and the first progenitor from the Warlord Dominion who came to Itogami Island to initially hunt down Christoper Gardos, but it turns out that he actually hired him to activate the Nalakuvera and do battle with it as a means to relive him of boredom, which in the end it was Kojou, Sayaka and Yukina who destroyed it. Though, it was pointed out that he may have some abnormal degree of affection toward Kojou, it is suggested that he is more interested on the Kaleid Blood that flows inside Kojou's veins that was passed on by Avrora than Kojou himself.

After the Nalakuvera incited, he establishes a "Warlord Dominion" consulate at Itogami Island and becomes its consul.

(Source: Anime +)

An employee of Magnus Craft. She wields a spear containing the Familiar "Jabra." Though her immediate superior is Kensei Kanase, she is the one who is pulling all the strings because she happens to be the rainmaker in the organization. She is also the one who orders Lowe Kirishima around.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Aya Tokoyogi is the main antagonist of the _Fiesta For the Observers_ arc in the anime/light novel series Strike the Blood.

Prior to the events of the Fiesta For the Observers arc, she was imprisoned within the Prison Barrier due to crimes that aren't mentioned or known but are considerably vile enough for the fact she was imprisoned for eternity among monsters and other dangerous supernatural criminals.
